caseNameFull: Adoptive Couple v. Baby Girl, a Minor Child Under the Age of 14 Years

opinions.text: Sup. Ct. S. C. [Certio-rari granted, ante, p. 1081.] Motion of petitioners for leave to file joint appendix under seal denied without prejudice to filing a renewed motion together with either a redacted joint appendix or an explanation as to why the joint appendix may not be redacted within 14 days.
